name: place-ember-field
setup: subwave.worldClock.setDayFraction(0.32); subwave.jumpTo('ember'); subwave.player.lampOn = true; const c = subwave.renderer.camera;window.__pin=(window.__pin||0)+1; const tok=window.__pin;(function pin(){ if(window.__pin!==tok) return; const tx=-2104, ty=-676.9, tz=-1680;const p=subwave.player; p.position[0]=-2052; p.position[1]=-666.6; p.position[2]=-1628;p.prevPosition.set(p.position); p.velocity.fill(0); p.oxygen=p.oxygenCapacity;const dx=tx-p.position[0], dy=ty-(p.position[1]+1.68), dz=tz-p.position[2];const dd=Math.hypot(dx,dy,dz); const yy=Math.atan2(dx,-dz), pp=Math.asin(dy/dd); p.yaw=yy; p.pitch=pp; c.setEuler(yy, pp, 0); requestAnimationFrame(pin); })();
